findings.summary: Page never states the monthly employee contribution; reader had to compute ~₪300 themselves.
Unclear which amount actually reaches the bank and what 'בכסף של היום' (today's money) means for the real figure.
The '123 ממקור / 123 מחושב' legend and rule/tag chips (KH-19, PF-18, חוקים וכללים) are unexplained.
Figures 15,712 ₪ and 20,566 ₪ in 'מה זה' are unclear; reader doesn't know if they are a limit on them.
Jargon not understood: אג"ח tracks, מסלול השקעה, whether 0.54% management fee is high, מס רווחי הון, etc.
Paragraph under the big chart loses the reader with inflation details and numbers like 321 ₪ / 66,601–66,280 ₪.
Tax section has too many conditions; unclear why 47% is withheld and whether the pink striped tax area is lost or partly refunded.
Top 1–12 year chart has no legend for the bar colours.
Big chart shows a number only on the deposit bar; no figure on 'נשאר בידיים' and no written-out amount for 6 years.
Missing info: the box about leaving the employer was cut off; also unclear what the money can be used for, which company and how to join, and whether 7% is realistic.
